cards.text: Stephen, one of the seven men chosen to help with the church's daily food distribution (Acts 6:1-5), is standing in front of the Sanhedrin, the Jewish ruling council (Acts 6:12). False witnesses say he never stops speaking against this holy place and against the law, and I bet you could hear a crumb drop in that room (Acts 6:13). Then the high priest turns to Stephen.

cards.question: Stephen stands before the council with false witnesses speaking against him. What does the high priest ask him?

answers.text: Who gave him the right to teach

cards.text: Stephen doesn't give a yes or a no. He says, “Brothers and fathers, listen to me!” and goes ALL the way back, like when you ask somebody how their day was and they start with the year they were born.

He starts with the God of glory appearing to Abraham, the man he calls “our father,” while Abraham was still in Mesopotamia. God tells him, “Leave your country and your kindred and go to the land I will show you.”

cards.question: God tells Abraham to leave his country and his kindred and go to the land God will show him. What does Abraham do?

answers.text: He leaves and settles in Haran
He waits for God to send a sign
He sends a servant to look first

cards.text: Abraham GOES without even knowing where, like following a map app that only ever says “Start driving.” After his father dies, God brings him from Haran into the land the council is living in now.

cards.question: Abraham gets no inheritance in that land, not even a foot of ground. But God promises to give it to Abraham and his ___.

cards.text: And Abraham doesn't even have a child yet. God tells him his descendants will be foreigners in a strange land, enslaved and mistreated four hundred years.

cards.question: God says He will ___ the nation that enslaves Abraham's descendants.
God says He will punish the nation that enslaves Abraham's descendants. Afterward, where does He say they will worship Him?

answers.text: In the land He brought Abraham to
In the land where they were slaves
In the land Abraham left behind

cards.text: Then God gives Abraham the covenant of circumcision, and Abraham becomes the father of Isaac.

cards.question: Abraham circumcises his son Isaac.

cards.text: Isaac becomes the father of Jacob, and Jacob of the twelve patriarchs. The patriarchs are jealous of their brother Joseph, so they sell him as a slave into Egypt.

cards.question: But God is with Joseph. He rescues Joseph from all his troubles and gives him favor and wisdom in front of Pharaoh king of Egypt. What does Pharaoh make Joseph?

answers.text: Ruler over Egypt and Pharaoh's household

cards.text: Then famine and great suffering sweep across Egypt and Canaan, and Jacob's family can't find food.

cards.question: Jacob hears there's ___ in Egypt, so he sends his sons on their first visit.
Jacob's sons travel to Egypt, where their brother Joseph now rules. On their second visit, what does Joseph do?

answers.text: He reveals who he is to them
He sends them home with nothing
He has them thrown in prison

cards.text: Joseph sends for his father Jacob and all his relatives, seventy-five in all. SEVENTY-FIVE people showing up at once, and I thought six cookie cutter kids made my counter crowded.

cards.question: Jacob stays behind in Canaan while the rest of his family goes down to Egypt.

cards.text: Jacob goes down to Egypt, and there he and his sons die. Their bones are carried back to Shechem and placed in the tomb Abraham had bought there.
Back in Egypt, as the time draws near for God to fulfill His promise to Abraham, Israel's people grow greatly in number. Then another king arises over Egypt, one who knew nothing of Joseph.

cards.question: This new king, who knew nothing of Joseph, treats Israel's people kindly.

cards.text: He oppresses them, forcing them to abandon their infants so they would die. At that time Moses is born, and when he's set outside, Pharaoh's daughter takes him and brings him up as her own son.

cards.question: Moses grows up as the son of Pharaoh's daughter. What is he educated in?

answers.text: All the wisdom of the Egyptians
The laws of the Hebrew elders
The ways of the desert tribes

cards.text: He's powerful in speech and action. At forty, he visits his brothers, the children of Israel, sees one being mistreated, and strikes down the Egyptian oppressing him.

cards.question: Moses assumes his brothers will understand that God is using him to ___ them.

cards.text: His brothers don't understand. The next day Moses tries to make peace between two fighting Israelites, and the one mistreating his neighbor shoves HIM aside, like calming down an argument at work only to find out YOU'RE the problem.

cards.question: The man says to Moses, “Who made you ruler and judge over us? Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?” What does Moses do next?

answers.text: He flees to the land of Midian
He goes back to Pharaoh's palace
He turns himself in to Pharaoh

cards.text: After forty years, an angel appears to Moses in the flames of a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai. Moses marvels at the sight, and as he comes closer to look, the voice of the Lord comes to him.

cards.question: The Lord's voice says, “I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.” What does Moses do?

answers.text: He trembles and doesn't dare look
He asks the voice for a sign
He runs back to his flock

cards.text: The Lord tells him, “Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.” He says He has seen the oppression of His people in Egypt, heard their groaning, and come down to deliver them.

cards.question: Then the Lord tells Moses He will send him back to ___.
The man who pushed Moses aside asked, “Who made you ruler and judge?” Stephen says God sent that same Moses to be their ruler and ___.

cards.text: Moses leads them out, doing wonders and signs in Egypt, at the Red Sea and for forty years in the wilderness. Stephen says this is the same Moses who told the Israelites, “God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers.”

cards.question: Stephen says Moses received “living words to pass on to us.” But Israel's fathers refused to ___ him.

cards.text: In their hearts they turn back to Egypt. They tell Aaron, Moses' brother (Exodus 4:14), “Make us gods who will go before us!”

cards.question: The people make a calf and offer a sacrifice to the idol.

cards.text: They rejoice in the works of their hands. But God turns away from them and gives them over to the worship of the host of heaven.

cards.question: Stephen quotes Amos 5:25-27, where God asks if they brought Him sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness. They carried along the tabernacle of Molech and the star of Rephan, idols they made to worship. What does God say He will do?

answers.text: Send them into exile beyond Babylon
Lead them back to Mount Sinai
Hand them back over to Pharaoh

cards.text: Pause right there, friend. Stephen's still got the floor, and he is NOT finished.
